description: Header file defining DNS resolving library API, including enums, structs, function prototypes, and macros for DNS query handling in Zephyr OS.

methods.name: dns_resolve_init
methods.description: Initializes DNS resolving context with specified server addresses.

methods.name: dns_resolve_init_default
methods.description: Initializes DNS resolving context with default system options.

methods.name: dns_resolve_reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures DNS context with new server list.

methods.name: dns_resolve_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a pending DNS query by ID.

methods.name: dns_resolve_cancel_with_name
methods.description: Cancels a pending DNS query by ID, name, and type.

methods.name: dns_resolve_name
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves a DNS name to an IP address.

methods.name: dns_resolve_get_default
methods.description: Returns the default system DNS resolve context.

methods.name: dns_get_addr_info
methods.description: Convenience inline function to resolve address info using default context.
